{{Gemini}}

Gemini is the 7th month of the [[Gaian calendar]]. It contains 28 days (4 weeks) and corresponds to ISO weeks 25–28.

== Overview ==
===Etymology===
English ''Gemini'' "twins" (Latin). Japanese: {{ill|双子座|ja|Futago-za}} “twins-constellation.”  
===Gaiad themes===
Weeks 25–28 (Days [[Gemini 1]]–[[Gemini 28]]):   
===EVENTS===
* [[Gemini 14]] — [[:Category:Days_that_Nagoshi_no_Ōharai_falls_on|Nagoshi_no_Ōharai]] (official day)  
* [[Gemini 21]] — [[:Category:Days_that_Tanabata_falls_on|Tanabata]]  
* [[Gemini 28]] — Bastille Day
